description: Change one take of a generation this account made, from the take itself: say what is off in the user's words (change, any language) or name the action. Three versions come back (a light, medium and strong change; for a loop, three seams) as CC0 WAV files. Free: no generation is used and no plan is needed. When the words ask for a different sound rather than a change to this one, it answers no_action with a description to pass to generate_sound. The user should listen and pick one.

action.description: crisper: too muddy; heavier: too light; shorter_tail: rings on too long; longer_tail: stops too abruptly; room: too dry; far: too close; loop: make it loop

change.description: What is off, in the user's words: 'too muddy', 'make it loop', 'sounds too close'

order_id.description: The generation, from generate_sound or get_generation

name: change_sound
